description: Water Distribution System 6: KY 6 is a data set deposited in uky.lib by its authors Lindell E. Ormsbee. KY 6 is primarily a loop system in Kentucky with the following assets: 3 Tanks, 2 Pumps, 1 Water Treatment Plant, and approximately 308719 feet of pipe. KY 6 provides 1.56 million gallons of water per day to its 2,850 customers at a rate which ranges between $7.38 and $8.12 per 1,000 gallons of water. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
